senses.gloss:
Ante-vāsin, ‘dwelling near,’ is the epithet of the Brahmacārin who lives in the house of his teacher. The expression does not occur before the late brāhmaṇa period. Secrecy is often enjoined on others than Antevāsins.
Foot notes Satapatha brāhmaṇa, v. 1, 5, 17; Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, vi. 3, 7; Chāndogya upaniṣad, iii. 11, 5; iv. 10, 1; taittirīya upaniṣad, i. 3, 3; 11, 1.
aitareya Āraṇyaka, iii. 2, 6; Sāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka, viii, 11.
